items.title: Reaction-Diffusion Xenopods
items.basis: The repo mentions a roadmap item for a Reaction-Diffusion module (Turing patterns). This can be interpreted as generating complex, self-organizing structures.
items.prompt: A field of 12 independent, alien, closed contour glyphs. Each glyph is a highly detailed, organic, self-organized pattern derived from reaction-diffusion processes. The forms are intricate, with fine branches and bulbous growths, resembling microscopic organisms or complex chemical precipitates. Rendered as pure black shapes on a white background. No shading, gradients, or textures. Shapes should be broad and solid.
items.why_weird: Generates abstract biological-like forms from a purely mathematical process, suggesting emergent alien life seeded by chemical reactions.

items.title: Entropy Masked Xenoworms
items.basis: The repo lists 'Entropy mask + glitch accumulation' as a roadmap item, suggesting the application of random or chaotic processes to create visual artifacts.
items.prompt: A canvas displaying 10 unique, abstract, closed contour glyphs. Each glyph is a sinuous, worm-like form, corrupted by controlled entropy and glitch accumulation. The contours are broken and reformed in unexpected ways, with sharp edges and abrupt changes in thickness, mimicking digital corruption or chaotic decay. Pure black on white.
items.why_weird: These glyphs represent data corruption as a form of alien biological mutation, where digital noise becomes a physical, transformative force.

items.title: Noise Field Xenocrypts
items.basis: The repo includes 'noise fields' in its description for math texture synthesis, implying the use of procedural noise for generative art.
items.prompt: Present 8 distinct, closed contour glyphs, each an intricate cryptogram generated from underlying noise fields. The shapes are complex, with fractal-like details and interwoven structures, suggesting an alien language or unknown mathematical constructs. Forms are robust, using thick bands of black on white.
items.why_weird: Alien script not designed for communication, but as a byproduct of fundamental physical noise processes, implying a universe where information is a chaotic accident.

Rendered as solid black shapes on a white background.
items.why_weird: Visualizes the output of a literal prompt distillation process, suggesting alien flora that are the direct, uninterpreted output of complex computational intent.
